title: 第14章 我是齐学长的未婚妻！
slug: 学霸女神超给力全本免费-学霸女神超给力最新章节列表
content_zh:
边上的凌潇潇低声跟韩露露说：“我看她不像在说假话，而且我好像听说她喜欢的是齐子衡……”
韩露露冷笑一声，养着下巴对着云画：“就算你说的是真的。那我再问你，你有没有勾引贺御翔！有没有约贺御翔在小桃林见面！”
你有没有勾引贺御翔！”
云画顿时就瞪大了眼睛，一脸气愤地跺脚：“你胡说什么，你别胡说！我我我……我怎么可能会勾引贺御翔！怎么可能约他见面！我疯了吗？我又不喜欢他！”
“那你喜欢谁？”韩露露问，“贺御翔说他收到你的短信，约他晚昨晚上在小桃林见面……”
“韩露露你别胡说！”云画好像一脸着急的样子，她咬牙说道，“我早就有喜欢的人了！我怎么可能约贺御翔！”
“呵呵，不就是喜欢齐子衡么，真是笑话，那可是齐子衡哎，咱们南溪有史以来最帅最有才华的齐子衡学长……你以为你是谁？也不照照镜子，就你？哼，不自量力！”韩露露的跟班凌潇潇，毫不留情地讥讽。
云画的脸顿时涨红，她就好像是被激怒了一样，大声说道：“我就是喜欢齐学长怎么了！敢说我不自量力？哼，不怕告诉你们，我可是齐学长的未婚妻！”
云画的话，让所有人都愣住了。
紧接着就是哄堂大笑！
韩露露和凌潇潇简直笑得都直不起腰来了。
“哎呦露露，你听见她说什么了吗？她说她是齐学长的未婚妻耶，哈哈哈，真是笑死我了，齐学长人帅心好，顺手帮她几次，她还真当齐学长对她有意思了？”凌潇潇笑得眼泪都出来了。
韩露露也是一脸鄙夷，她冷漠地看了云画一眼：“真是癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉，果然是农村出来的，不自量力的很。你知道齐学长什么家世吗？呵呵，还想当齐学长的未婚妻？齐学长家保姆的女儿都比你金贵！”
云画的脸色瞬间就一阵青一阵白，好像是被打击到了一样。
她气愤地推了韩露露一下：“我就是齐学长的未婚妻，你们不信的话可以去问齐学长！”
“当我们傻啊，呵呵，真是病得不轻，脑子都坏掉了。”凌潇潇撇嘴，一脸幸灾乐祸。
“你们……你们别不信，我会证明给你们看的！”云画气得直接推开了凌潇潇，恼羞成怒一般地跑了。
韩露露和凌潇潇倒是没在意云画推她俩的举动，反倒是不屑一顾，她们压根儿就不相信云画的话！
开什么玩笑，云画她爸就是个小小的保安公司的老板，云画和她妈也是前年才刚被从农村接到城里来，云家算什么家世？说白了比一般进城打工的农民好了那么一点，但也还是农民。
而齐家，齐老爷子，那可不是一般人能攀得上的！

齐家乃是豪门望族，齐子衡又是齐家长孙，以后必定是要跟门当户对的世家名媛联姻的。
怎么着……都轮不到一家子农民出身的云画！

content_en:
Ling Xiaoxiao, who was standing next to her, whispered to Han Lulu: "I don't think she is telling lies, and I seem to have heard that she likes Qi Ziheng..."
Han Lulu sneered and raised her chin to face Yun Hua: "Even if what you said is true. Then let me ask you again, did you seduce He Yuxiang! Did you ask He Yuxiang to meet in Xiao Taolin!"
Have you ever seduced He Yuxiang? "
Yun Hua's eyes widened immediately and he stamped his feet angrily: "What are you talking nonsense about? Don't talk nonsense! Me, me, me...how could I seduce He Yuxiang! How is it possible to ask him to meet! Am I crazy? I don't like him! "
"Then who do you like? Han Lulu asked, "He Yuxiang said that he received your text message and asked him to meet at Xiaotaolin last night..."
"Han Lulu, don't talk nonsense! Yun Hua seemed to have a worried look on her face. She gritted her teeth and said, "I already have someone I like!" How could I possibly date He Yuxiang! "
"Haha, don't you just like Qi Ziheng? What a joke, that's Qi Ziheng, the most handsome and talented senior Qi Ziheng in the history of Nanxi... Who do you think you are? You don’t even look in the mirror, is it just you? Humph, you don’t overestimate your capabilities! " Han Lulu's follower Ling Xiaoxiao sneered mercilessly.
Yun Hua's face suddenly turned red, and she seemed to be irritated, and said loudly: "I just like Senior Qi, what's wrong! Dare you say that I am overestimating my abilities? Hum, I’m not afraid to tell you, I am Senior Qi’s fiancée! "
Yun Hua's words stunned everyone.
What followed was a roar of laughter!
Han Lulu and Ling Xiaoxiao could hardly stand upright with laughter.
"Hey Lulu, did you hear what she said? She said she was Senior Qi's fiancée, hahaha, it really made me laugh. Senior Qi is handsome and kind-hearted. He helped her a few times. Did she really think that Senior Qi was interested in her? "Ling Xiaoxiao laughed so hard that tears came out.
Han Lulu also had a look of disdain on her face. She glanced at Yun Hua indifferently: "It's really a toad that wants to eat swan meat. It turns out that he comes from the countryside and he overestimates his abilities. Do you know what Senior Qi’s family background is? Haha, you still want to be Senior Qi’s fiancée? Senior Qi’s nanny’s daughter is more valuable than you! "
Yun Hua's face turned blue and white instantly, as if he had been hit.
She pushed Han Lulu angrily: "I am Senior Qi's fiancée. If you don't believe it, you can ask Senior Qi! "
"Think we are stupid, haha, we are really very sick and our brains are broken. "Ling Xiaoxiao pouted, looking gloating.
"You...don't believe it, I will prove it to you! Yun Hua was so angry that he pushed Ling Xiaoxiao away and ran away in anger.
Han Lulu and Ling Xiaoxiao didn't care about Yun Hua's push towards them. Instead, they dismissed it. They didn't believe Yun Hua's words at all!
Are you kidding? Yun Hua's father is the owner of a small security company. Yun Hua and her mother were just brought to the city from the countryside the year before last. What kind of family background is the Yun family? To put it bluntly, they are a little better than ordinary farmers who work in cities, but they are still farmers.
As for the Qi family, Mr. Qi is not something that ordinary people can reach!
The Qi family is a wealthy family, and Qi Ziheng is the grandson of the Qi family. In the future, he will definitely marry a lady from a well-matched family.
What's going on...it's not Yun Hua's turn who comes from a peasant family!
If you like the goddess of academic tyranny, she’s so awesome. Please give her a thumbs up.
